knownLimits: All tests in this successor remain unrun. Root owns matching combined validation and release acceptance.
Headless isolated export has no GUI recovery provider, quit ledger, durable recovery store, or imported close authority. Password encryption remains independent of volatile storage.
The cleanup grace only initiates terminal native shutdown. It is never proof of completion, and actual native/JS finalizers may deliberately keep an unprovable shutdown pending.
The terminal stopSettled API refuses future admissions/restart on that client. Legacy stop remains restartable when terminal shutdown was never requested.
Actual subprocess source cases use a synthetic Node protocol worker. They do not certify the Rust executable, package inclusion, signing, or full desktop process tree.
Generic Root external file-move refresh and broader combined GUI/quit behavior remain Root-owned acceptance paths.
